verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a full ad-hoc Query Builder with defined clauses (SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/LIMIT/HAVING), relational field prefixes, BubbleUp for outlier investigation, and even a Query Assistant for natural-language querying, all clearly documented for interactive exploration. Community evidence corroborates it accelerates ad hoc investigations in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of query language expressiveness/limitations beyond vendor docs.
